purpose: Test whether pretraining a small specialist-fusion fallback for each sensor-availability state is safer and more useful than fabricating missing XRS/proton measurements.

training.specialists: same five-seed XGBoost experts and hyperparameters as IRIS_CROSSFIT_EVIDENCE_STACK_V1
training.inner_folds: same four expanding chronological fit-only folds as crossfit evidence stack
training.fusion: PositiveEvidenceStack with nonnegative coefficients and existing regularization; expert_count equals available expert count
training.solar_only: existing five-seed solar expert; no invented XRS/proton values

evaluation.event_terminal_selection: exact event-terminal positive + deterministic quiet-control selection contract from the preregistered 2026-09-06 outage experiment
evaluation.paired_bootstrap_unit: event-terminal identity / matched quiet control for affected rows; complete episode/quiet block for whole-score comparisons

operator_promotion_rule.NORMAL: FORBIDDEN from this development extension regardless of point estimate; fresh independent evaluation is required.
DEGRADED_CANDIDATE: whole-score Brier degradation versus clean full stack <= 0.01
whole-score ECE degradation versus clean full stack <= 0.02
no nonfinite probability and no unresolved unavailable expert is silently substituted
operator_promotion_rule.ABSTAIN: required for an availability state that fails any DEGRADED_CANDIDATE criterion

comparison.note: Prior simple-recovery outcomes are already inspected and are contextual comparators, not fresh selection evidence.

claim_boundary: A successful result supports an availability-conditioned DEGRADED research fallback. It does not establish operational certification, raw-sensor reconstruction accuracy, or final superiority.
